about: Animated look (how-to card): opening of a Communication Clarity guide.

scenes.narration: Getting to the point is a kindness to the people you talk to.

lines: A long route to the point loses them.

scenes.narration: When a message or a meeting update takes a long route to its point, people drift, guess, or miss what you needed from them.
Getting to the point doesn't mean being blunt or cold. It means knowing what you want to say, saying it early, and stopping once it has landed.
A friend who texts, can you pick up Sam at four, gets a faster yes than one who sends five lines about their afternoon first.
This guide shows you how: know your point before you speak, lead with the bottom line, and stay warm while being brief.
Notice one long message you receive today. Ask yourself where the actual point was, and how long it took to arrive.
